predicate.label: member of organization
predicate.definition: Person, country or organization X is or becomes a member of organization, alliance, party or public body Y.
includes: join/accession/entry when organizational membership is established
individual legislators and countries in alliances
excludes: join a person in an action
ambiguous: bare join without clear completion or membership meaning
plural party naming individual members rather than the party itself
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit member/belong/membership; join/accession/entry when organizational membership is established; individual legislators and countries in alliances. Excludes: join a person in an action; geographic entry; event participation; party control of legislature; negotiations or proposed membership alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare join without clear completion or membership meaning; plural party naming individual members rather than the party itself.

rationale: Ordered-role inspection identifies nine accession/admission/entry rows for Poland→EU and China→WTO, the strongest coherent institutional family, versus seven travel/entry rows to physical or office destinations. Select membership rather than conflate institutional accession and physical movement; go alone remains insufficient.
